text: I don't believe in failure. It is not failure if you enjoyed the process.
author: Oprah Winfrey

archive.text: The word happy would lose its meaning if it were not balanced by sadness.
archive.author: Carl Jung

archive.text: Wisdom is the supreme part of happiness.
archive.author: Sophocles

archive.text: What does not kill me makes me stronger.
archive.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

archive.text: There is nothing you can see that is not a flower; there is nothing you can think that is not the moon.
archive.author: Matsuo Basho

archive.text: If you shut the door to all errors, truth will be shut out.
archive.author: Rabindranath Tagore

archive.text: Solitude is the profoundest fact of the human condition. Man is the only being who knows he is alone.
archive.author: Octavio Paz

archive.text: What is the hardest of all? That which seems easiest for your eyes: to see what is lying before your eyes.
archive.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
